messages:
Sally (AE): Quick sync on Aurora POC — confirm sandbox ingest flow and lock acceptance criteria this week. Starting with sample CDRs + call transcripts. Need redaction + evals. @Mike pricing?
Mike (SE): Can join call today. We can offer a 2-week trial: 50k free tokens + infra credits. Dedicated slot requires finance OK.
Elena (Solutions): Proposed flow: customer uploads to SFTP -> staging S3 -> redaction pipeline (regex + NER) -> redacted S3 prefix. We can provide a pre-redacted CSV to unblock early evals. Redaction QA uses a 500-sample audit.
Jacob (Infra): I can provision a VPC-isolated sandbox in us-west-2. Options: allowlist CIDR egress or SFTP via bastion. ETA 24-48h after access request.
Sally (AE): Proposed acceptance criteria:
- AC1: End-to-end ingest + redaction demo with sample dataset in sandbox
- AC2: Redaction precision >= 99% on a 500-sample audit set
- AC3: Confirmed SFTP ingest and verified writes to redacted S3 path
- AC4: Inference p95 < 150ms for 512-token gen on hosted config (or parity on Dedicated)
- AC5: Run 100 eval prompts, no quality regression vs baseline
Please confirm.
Mike (SE): Looks good. Add token budget: cap trial at 100k tokens to prevent runaway tests. Also flag: if they request a 60-90 day Dedicated trial we need legal + security sign-off (SOC2 related).
Elena (Solutions): I'll prepare a 10-prompt eval pack (summarize, extract action items, identify entities, redact, paraphrase) with expected structured outputs. Example prompt: 'Summarize this call and extract action items with owners' -> expected JSON: action_items[], owners[]. We'll evaluate owner extraction by F1 score.
Jacob (Infra): infra-bot: sandbox-aurora-2006543210 provisioning started. S3 path: s3://redwood-sandbox/aurora/2006543210/temp/ Credentials will be generated and emailed; expires in 7d.
Sally (AE): Jacob please add SFTP example commands and confirm credentials will be seeded into LastPass. Elena, you'll own redaction QA and produce the audit report template. Mike to send updated SOW + trial credit note to the customer. I'll schedule kickoff 10:00 PT tomorrow and invite Aurora. Keep updates in this thread, add blockers. :thumbsup:
